Questions owners ask us

Will my customers know a bot is involved?+

No. Your assistant is set up entirely under your business's name, voice and branding. Customers chat with your brand and see your content — that is all they ever see.

Do I have to approve every post?+

You are always in control. Videos and posts wait in your owner portal's approval queue, and you pick which of the 3–4 options goes live. Nothing is published behind your back.

What do you need from me to start?+

Just the free 15-minute audit call. We look at your pages, your services and your competitors, and map out exactly what your daily pack, inbox and order handling would cover.

My business is small — one branch. Is this for me?+

Yes — Rana AI OS is built first for owner-run businesses with 1 to 5 branches: salons, clinics, restaurants and boutiques where the owner cannot sit on Instagram all day.

What if something on my account goes wrong?+

Your portal shows account issues and alerts as soon as they appear, and we work with you to clear them — you are never left guessing why a page went quiet.

How do we talk about price?+

On the audit call. Every business's workload is different, so we first understand your pages, your order volume and your goals — then talk numbers with the full picture in front of us.
